messages:
Alyssa (PM): Quick sync — proposing a model rotation plan for our catalog entries used by enterprise customers. Goal: reduce cost by switching to LLM-X-quant while keeping quality within 2% of baseline. Thoughts?
Mike (Eng): sounds reasonable. need to confirm latency impact under bursty traffic. p95 target still 200ms right?
Sara (SRE): yes p95 <= 200ms. we should require canary traffic at 1% in prod for 24h and perf telemetry dashboard before ramp.
Diego (ML): evals show LLM-X-quant has +0.8% rouge on our summarization suite but drops on a few customer prompts. we should add a small prompt-suite from top 10 customers.
Priya (CS): I can collect customer-critical prompts and flag any that hit >3% quality drop. customers A and C asked for notification windows.
Alyssa (PM): Acceptance criteria draft:
- Quality: overall eval delta <= 2% vs current model on golden set
- No customer prompt >3% degradation (customer-suite)
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms on production traffic profile
- Error rate: <0.1% increase
- Rollback plan and comms completed
Mike (Eng): rollout playbook snippet:
```bash
# canary
set route model=LLM-X-quant --weight 1% --duration 24h
monitor perf-dashboard --alerts "latency>200ms or delta>2%"
# ramp
if stable: increase to 10% for 6h, then 50% for 12h, then full
``` 
Sara (SRE): also require GPU memory checks and fallback to float32 variant when OOMs detected. add autoscale policy for burst.
Diego (ML): scoring thresholds and tie-break rules for reranker changes — add to spec. we'll include a regression suite and A/B via deduped sessions.
Priya (CS): customer notifications: 7-day heads-up + post-change summary with opt-out URL. legal wants a 30-day SLA note if degradation occurs.
Alyssa (PM): Action items:
- @Priya collect customer prompt suite by EOD Thu
- @Diego produce regression report + threshold config by next Tue
- @Mike draft rollout config + fallback by Mon
- @Sara add canary runbook and dashboard widgets by Wed
Priya (CS): ack, will start outreach.
Mike (Eng): ack, will draft and link to /runbooks/catalog-rotations
deploy-bot: Canary started for LLM-X-quant at 1% traffic — ts=2380014000 :rocket:
Diego (ML): initial canary metrics look fine — quality delta 0.9%, p95 185ms. continuing monitoring.
Priya (CS): customer B reported minor wording shift, filed as ticket CS-492.
Alyssa (PM): good first pass. we'll reconvene after 24h canary. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Mike (Eng): +1
Sara (SRE): +1
